tool.name: Idira Secure AI Agents
tool.description: Discovers AI agents across SaaS, cloud and dev environments and brokers their MCP tool access with just-in-time privilege and audit.
tool.practitionerNote: Fits organisations already on CyberArk PAM that want agent access routed through a broker; the May 2026 Idira rebrand means docs and URLs are still moving.
tool.statusNote: CyberArk's platform was rebranded as Idira by Palo Alto Networks in May 2026.

dataResidency.detail: Data residency for Secure AI Agents is not stated on the Idira pages reviewed.

deployment.detail: Delivered as part of the Idira identity security platform; agent traffic routed through the Agent Identity Broker. Self-hosted options not stated.

auditLogging.detail: Logs capture which agent requested what action and when, via the Identity Broker.

soc2.detail: Palo Alto Networks trust center lists SOC 2 Type II for Palo Alto Networks but does not name Idira or CyberArk products in scope.

iso27001.detail: Palo Alto Networks ISO 27000 page does not list Idira or CyberArk products in scope.

iso42001.detail: Palo Alto Networks lists ISO 42001, but Idira/CyberArk product scope is not stated.

euAiAct.detail: Identity and access-control tooling for agents, not itself an AI system placed on the market; AI Act obligations rest with the provider/deployer of the governed agents.

licenseRisk.detail: Proprietary Palo Alto Networks (Idira) product; no open-source edition.
